subject: How do you use _rows_selected if data isn't bound on load?

messages.author: 058340136701906d
messages.subject: How do you use _rows_selected if data isn't bound on load?
parts:
I've spent today trying to figure out how to use _rows_selected if data is not present on load (I'm sure I'm missing something).  We have been playing around with shiny quickly develop some apps to look at large databases of data.  So it doesn't make sense to load all data on the load of the page, we have user input to build a select sql string to query the database.  All of the examples I can find for using _rows_selected have the data on load, so that all the jquery bindings can be built.  How do you rebind the jquery to the data after the search so that _rows_selected != null.

I've created a simple example so that hopefully someone can show me the theory.

ui.R
library(shiny)

navbarPage(
  
  title = 'DT Selection',
  
  tabPanel(
    'Car Picker',
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        textInput("car", "Search string for car"),
        submitButton("Go"),
        verbatimTextOutput('testOutput'),
        width = 2
      ),
      mainPanel(DT::dataTableOutput("carList"))
    )
  )
)


server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  mtcars$carName <- rownames(mtcars)
  
  output$carList <- DT::renderDataTable({
    searchStr <- input$car
    
    if (searchStr != "")  sqldf(paste0("select * from mtcars where carName like '%",searchStr,"%'"))
  }, selection = 'single', rownames = F)
  
  output$testOutput = renderPrint(input$carList_rows_selected)
})

parts:
Sorry I didn't get it. Since you have a submitButton() in the app, you
have to click the button every time you make a change in the app (e.g.
after you type a search string in the search box or click a row in the
table). I don't know what "rebind the jquery to the data after the
search so that _rows_selected != null" means.

Regards,
Yihui
